exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: five selected comic panels in one deterministic sequence sheet for CH05 CH05-S01
Primary request: Create a text-free 3-by-2 comic grid. The first five cells are the chronological story sequence below. The sixth cell is a quiet environment-only aftermath motif, never a duplicate character panel.
Scene/backdrop: The outer maintenance rib above Hook Market, where a grated service ledge overlooks awnings beginning to pull east toward the wall-sea. in Veyr, a gravity-rationed city built beside a continent-high vertical ocean.
Characters: Mae Nox, fictional adult woman age 41, tall and broad-shouldered, dark brown skin, one blunt black wedge braid to shoulder blades, ochre work coat, teal rope harness, heavy split-toe boots, practical mature proportions; Dax Pell, fictional adult man age 38, lean, copper-brown skin, silver-black asymmetrical curl crest leaning left, narrow moustache, coral half-cape, charcoal wrap trousers, yellow barometer gauntlet, practical mature proportions.
Non-human subjects: juvenile_keelback, glass_skate.
Style/medium: pressure-print comic: bold woodcut-like dry-brush black edges, flat imperfect off-register oxidized teal, warning coral and acid-yellow risograph inks on warm fibrous paper; angular adult proportions, large readable hands, graphic negative-space force paths, simplified backgrounds except for functional machinery, one dominant value break per cell.
Color palette: coral-dominant danger, black structure, wider warm-paper silence.
Composition/framing: exact clean 3-column by 2-row grid with strong black gutters; one readable moment per cell; varied camera distance; phone-readable silhouettes; the first five cells must read left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
Chronological cells:
Cell 1: Establish The outer maintenance rib above Hook Market, where a grated service ledge overlooks awnings beginning to pull east toward the wall-sea.; show mae, dax, juvenile_keelback, glass_skate; make geography and current load direction obvious.
Cell 2: Intent: Document the chain entering the juvenile keelback before the changing lean hides it.; show the responsible adult initiating a concrete step.
Cell 3: Constraint becomes physical and visible: The ledge is narrowing under eastward pull, the freed glass skate is exhausted, and the anchor-heart must remain level in its triangular cradle..
Cell 4: Causal action: Mae braces the cradle against a rib pin while Dax uses his barometer gauntlet to align the chain's vibration with the coming market bell; the juvenile rolls, pulling the chain taut enough to expose a stamped Crown coupling.; show footing, contact, rope or mechanism tension, and force direction.
Cell 5: Consequence and remaining state: They confirm the animal is part of the civic load system, but the taut chain transmits a warning shudder into the market supports below.; nothing resets between cells.
Irreversible state already in force: official_forecast_disproved, mae_accepts_dax_forecast, south_hook_rib_cracked, mae_right_glove_torn, mae_pull_knot_charged, mae_pull_knot_spent, dax_wanted, public_witnesses_wrong_down, tavi_joins_investigation, engine_alarm_active, weight_diversion_proven, south_hook_knows_diversion, dax_cape_hem_scorched, anchor_heart_stolen, south_hook_detachment_ordered, mae_named_compromised, anchor_heart_shared_carry_protocol, south_hook_food_stores_reduced, mae_learns_dax_withheld_route_risk, mae_right_sleeve_torn, mae_ribs_bruised, supplies_lost, inspectors_owe_mae, inspectors_share_anchor_heart_load, tagged_glass_skate_discovered, mae_compression_wrap, dax_cape_lining_cut, maintenance_gill_crossed, council_pressure_harvest_proven, glass_skate_freed, dax_breath_knot_charged, juvenile_keelback_wound_seen, dax_breath_knot_spent, engine_chain_in_keelback_confirmed.
New state that must visibly persist after this sequence: The Council's Crown coupling on the juvenile keelback has been witnessed by both Mae and Dax., The maintenance-rib shudder has begun propagating into Hook Market., Mae retains the torn right sleeve and rib compression wrap; Dax retains the scorched cape hem..
Lettering clearance: cell 1 reserve normalized rectangle [0.06, 0.05, 0.28, 0.17] as low-detail negative space; cell 2 reserve normalized rectangle [0.58, 0.06, 0.94, 0.2] as low-detail negative space; cell 3 reserve normalized rectangle [0.06, 0.72, 0.44, 0.91] as low-detail negative space; cell 4 reserve normalized rectangle [0.67, 0.66, 0.94, 0.84] as low-detail negative space; cell 5 reserve normalized rectangle [0.06, 0.06, 0.52, 0.18] as low-detail negative space.
Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unambiguously mature proportions and practical non-sexualized clothing; exact named-character hair, silhouette, wardrobe damage, injuries and equipment persist; coherent anatomy; readable hands; visible physical cause and effect; no spontaneous healing; no extra people unless the cell explicitly calls for a fictional-adult crowd; no glamor posing.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, speech balloons, sound-effect text, logos, signatures, watermarks, floating UI, children, child-coded features, young-looking adults, sexual content, gratuitous gore, real-person likeness, third-party characters, named-artist imitation, glossy 3D, soft clear-line watercolor.
